subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Orient Express
description: A quick, practical guide to The Orient Express.

hook.text: In 1883, a luxury train left Paris for Constantinople. It became the most famous ride in history.

buildup.text: Passengers dined on five-course meals in velvet carriages rolling across Europe.

discovery.text: The Orient Express was more than transport—it was a symbol of elegance, intrigue, and adventure.

twist.text: Agatha Christie set a murder mystery on it. Real spies actually used it. Fact and fiction blurred.

climax.text: The original route ended in 1977, but the name still conjures a lost era of glamorous travel.

punchline.text: No train has ever been more mythologized.

quiz.question: Where did the original Orient Express run?
